about: Showcase recipes using the optional film-look stages in sim/effects.py (see docs/FILM_LOOK.md). Untested starting points, tuned by eye on testdata ORFs at 900 px. Sector order and conventions as in fuji_like.json.

camera_feasibility_legend.yes: maps onto an existing E-P7 ISP primitive with parameters only (LUT / matrix / 12-sector HSL / grain combiner / shading)
camera_feasibility_legend.maybe: needs an Art Filter blur/blend job re-parameterised (Soft Focus / Diorama path), not yet located in firmware
camera_feasibility_legend.no: no known primitive; desktop or post only

cinestill_800t.notes: Tungsten-balanced, remjet-free motion-picture stock: strong red-orange halation rings round lights, cool cast in daylight, cyan-leaning blacks, visible colour grain. Best on night or backlit scenes with point lights.

camera_feasibility.film_curve: yes-ish: per-channel RGB gamma LUT (crossover blacks) if the RGB-gamma unit accepts custom curves; otherwise tone levels only
camera_feasibility.halation: maybe: Soft Focus blur on a highlight-keyed, red-tinted copy; the tint and threshold need a LUT before the blur and an additive blend
camera_feasibility.bloom: maybe: Soft Focus blend at low strength
camera_feasibility.subtractive_saturation: approx: negative per-sector lightness on saturated sectors
camera_feasibility.grain_v2: partial: grain combiner has amplitude + luma mask; no size control, colour needs the colour-grain mod

portra_400_bloom.notes: Portra 400 overexposed ~1/3 stop through a 1/2 Black Pro-Mist: low contrast, very soft shoulder, warm pastel skin, glow that lifts shadows next to highlights, fine low-chroma grain.

camera_feasibility.film_curve: yes: luminance LUT (soft shoulder/lifted toe) + tone levels; per_channel part needs RGB gamma LUT
camera_feasibility.bloom: maybe: Soft Focus (I) is a blurred-copy blend; a real 1/2 Pro-Mist on the lens is the zero-firmware alternative

classic_neg_halation.notes: fuji_like.json classic_neg (hue twists, per-colour lightness, hard tone) plus Color Chrome Strong / FX Blue Weak, green-shadow / warm-highlight crossover, Grain Strong-Small and a moderate halation. The halation and bloom are NOT part of Fuji's Classic Neg.; they imitate a 'shot on film' version of it.

camera_feasibility.sat/hue/light/tone/contrast/wb: yes with HSL mod (same as fuji_like classic_neg)
camera_feasibility.color_chrome: approx: negative per-sector lightness (red/orange/yellow/green, blue for FX Blue), chroma-weighted in the ISP model
camera_feasibility.film_curve crossover: yes-ish via RGB gamma LUT; else no
camera_feasibility.grain_v2: partial (amplitude; Fuji 'Small' is close to per-pixel E-P7 grain)
